sourcePolicy: Only structural metadata and independently authored originals; no legacy question or media inputs.
changes: Five original-corpus near candidates replaced with independent pragmatic/lexical tasks.
Building evidence-preservation listening replaced with scoped repair-access/temporary-key procedure.
Written silence/consent passage replaced with request-email information order.
Vocabulary usage alternatives changed from unrelated physical absurdities to contextual lexical confusions.
Text-grammar alternative generalization concession removed to avoid a second defensible answer.
Eleven reading correct options condensed and three distractors made more specific; correct length no longer systematically maximal.

Two semantic-adjacent written themes replaced: short dictionary/pragmatics with markdown-price impact on later buying, and specialist-language argument with competitive rank/record/tactical decision analysis.
Grammar7 adds explicit acceptance of prior theory to rule out a second purpose-based interpretation.
Integrated sample story explicitly distinguishes returned/untouched material; 30 consumed plus10 observation leaves20 untouched in rejected plan.

All fourteen immediate-response alternatives rewritten in comparable natural register/length, avoiding systematic long polite correct responses. Gist and printed task alternatives condensed selectively; stable correct IDs retained. Regenerate every affected spoken alternative.
orderingReview: この資料は、一般公開を前提として作られたものではないにもかかわらず、無断で配布されていた。
今回の提案は、従来の制度を廃止するのではなく、その制度が持つ利点を生かしながら対象を広げようとするものだ。
問題は、数値の誤差が大きいかどうかということよりも、比較の条件がそろっていないことにある。
住民の中には、自分たちの意見がどのように計画に反映されたかを知りたいと考えている人もいる。
この技術を普及させるには、使い方を伝えるだけで十分だと考えるのは危険である。
distinctIntegratedDecisions: Sample consumption vs untouched reserve, both analyses and budget, observation returns but is not untouched.
Stage curtain exchange within spoken monologue: noise/time/no-blackout and one rehearsal.
Stargazing accessibility/time/lighting permit plus exceptional telephone notification; last story shared once.
limitations: AI reasoning and lexical candidate audit do not certify exhaustive semantic independence, native difficulty, pronunciation, rights or release.

readingOptionLengthCheck.policy: Length checked for systematic cue, not a forced shortest/longest quota.
